aboutPage.title: Rawafid Saba Equipment
aboutPage.subtitle: A Saudi company specialized in heavy equipment rental, lifting and handling equipment, and project support solutions — serving Riyadh and the Kingdom since 2018.
aboutPage.storyBody: Rawafid Saba began from a firm conviction: great projects aren't built by equipment alone, but by a partner who arrives on time, works safely, and lifts the project higher. From that conviction we grew — a fleet of 273+ machines, 732+ projects delivered, and the trust of 245+ clients across sectors.
aboutPage.visionBody: To be the first stream relied upon in contracting, heavy equipment rental, and facade works across the Kingdom — a Saudi brand that cities are built with and urban growth is documented by.
aboutPage.missionBody: We bring our expertise, equipment, and people into one stream of work — delivering projects with engineering precision, on-time and safe, and offering solutions that create lasting value for our clients, partners, and community.

reliability.desc: Our word is a contract; we honor time, spec, and cost — in easy conditions and hard ones.

safety.title: Safety
safety.desc: No project is worth an injury; human safety comes before speed and every other consideration.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.desc: We build relationships that span decades, not deals that end at handover.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.desc: Our clients, suppliers, and people are the streams of our success; we grow together or not at all.

ambition.title: Ambition
ambition.desc: We measure ourselves by global standards, and see in every project a step higher.
